statement: Native Dolphin 2503 MP+Nunchuk, compat shims off, reaches native device setup but all 14659 A400F6/4 requests receive error 7. No MP A40020/32 or child A40040/16 read occurs. This is consistent with bound-kernel contention and leaves the shim state gate unavailable; no live shim success or decoded Nunchuk/gyro is established. No driver or model change follows.
